module_summary: PS/2 packet receiver: a one-hot step FSM syncs on in[3] to frame 3-byte packets while a history shifter keeps the last three bytes, output on done.

anchors.name: tk
anchors.why: One-hot packet FSM state from fsm_i; bit 3 marks packet complete.

anchors.name: sh
anchors.why: 24-bit shift history of the last three received bytes.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Incoming byte stream fed to history and header check.

anchors.name: hdr_bit
anchors.why: in[3] header marker steering FSM synchronization.

groups.name: byte_history
groups.description: Shifts in bytes and presents last three as packet.
